import os, shutil, sqlite3, csv
src = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/Default/Login Data")
shutil.copy(src, "/tmp/login-copy.db")
rows = sqlite3.connect("/tmp/login-copy.db").execute("select origin_url, username_value from logins").fetchall()
with open(os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/chrome-logins.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
    csv.writer(f).writerows(rows)
os.remove("/tmp/login-copy.db")
